rule: C-0093, C-0101: a departure — a difference or ratio of two nearly equal DIMENSIONLESS numbers, emitted inside a reproductions or convergence record — carries two significant digits, because RESULT_ABSOLUTE_FLOOR is a claim in the locked units (P-18) and does not reach a ratio.
whyNotThirtyOneHandEdits: C-0131 measured the reason and did not apply it to its own residue: the rule survives correct per-file repairs. C-0093 cured it on the convergence axis, C-0101 in the reproduction records of eleven files, C-0127 found T-136 still carrying it, C-0129 re-keyed it into a constant, C-0131 re-emitted 35 files — five correct repairs, and a thirty-first file was left for the sixth. So the repair here is to the MECHANISM: DEPARTURE_DIGITS_BY_KEY becomes the baseline of roundedForResult's digitsByKey, and the three remaining independent rounding implementations that had no digitsByKey parameter at all delegate to it.
whyTheDefaultIsSafeNow: C-0131's bound 2 refused exactly this default, on a measurement: keyed on a LEAF NAME the map would have rounded T-193's electrode potentials, in volts, to two digits. That refusal is right about the map it was written against and does not survive the re-keying C-0131 performed in the same task — a record/spelling map cannot reach potentialOfZeroCharge/departure at all. The refusal was inherited one iteration past the fact that removed it.
